model.title: Midnight Rules Relief Act of 2025
model.meta: Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee · Sen. Ron Johnson (R-WI)

summary.text: The bill would allow Congress to disapprove multiple regulations issued near the end of a presidential term in a single vote, rather than requiring separate votes for each one. This aims to streamline the process for reviewing regulations that outgoing administrations put in place during their final year.
